source: Nexon, v.272 patch notes (news id 47132, 11 Nov 2026), Etherion Relics section; read 27 Nov 2026.
scope: Shared by every character on the account. Kills count only while solo or not in a party.
quote: 1 additional completion becomes available every Wednesday at 12:00 AM UTC, up to 12 times during the event period.
openNote: Nexon does not say whether a completion was open at launch on 11 Nov. Either way the 12th is open by Wed 3 Feb. The game shows how many are open now.

order.relic: Arcane River, Grandis Daily Quest Rewards

coreNote: You choose each core and the choice cannot be undone. A failed enhancement uses the Etherion but never lowers the core.

medal.reward: Etherion Overload Medal Coupon (the medal is permanent; the coupon expires 10 Feb 2027 02:00 UTC)

usableQuote: cannot be obtained or used after February 9, 2027 at 11:59 PM UTC.
dropNote: Nexon does not publish how much Etherion a kill or a boss drops, so the tracker can say how much you need but not how long it takes. Challenger World bosses (Kai, Mayrin) drop none.
